answer:
Let \(\mathfrak m=(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,z,w)\) and
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal P=\{&
(a,b),(c,d),(e,f),(g,h),(z,w),\\
&(a,c,e,z),(a,c,h,z),(a,d,e,w),(a,d,g,w),(a,f,g,w),(a,f,h,z),\\
&(b,c,f,w),(b,c,h,w),(b,d,f,z),(b,d,g,z),(b,e,g,z),(b,e,h,w),\\
&(c,e,g,z),(c,f,g,w),(d,e,h,w),(d,f,h,z)\}.
\end{aligned}
\]
For every field \(K\),
\[
\operatorname{Ass}_R(R/I^k)=
\begin{cases}
\mathcal P\cup\{\mathfrak m\},&k=2,\\
\mathcal P,&k=1\text{ or }k\geq3.
\end{cases}
\]
